name: iperf3 (Docker)
description: Docker containerization of iperf3, a standard tool for active measurements of maximum achievable bandwidth on IP networks supporting TCP, UDP, and SCTP.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker Hub image networkstatic/iperf3 with Dockerfile present; runs iperf3 in server mode to listen for connections

eval_notes: The standard tool for measuring network bandwidth between endpoints. Essential for validating throughput in simulated 5G environments. Lightweight Docker image allows easy deployment alongside core network simulators.
